response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the hum of ancient electronics.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a stout man with a bushy beard, sits upon his throne. He gazes out at his advisors, his eyes gleaming with an otherworldly intensity.

KING EVERARD
(leaning forward)
My friends, the time has come to revolutionize our aesthetic. We shall shed the drabness of our forebears and embrace the futuristic splendor of... (dramatic pause)...Vaporwave!

ADVISOR 1
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

KING EVERARD
(nodding)
Yes! The swirling clouds of nostalgia, the distorted beats, the eerie, pulsing lights. We shall infuse our empire with the essence of this mystical realm.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE COURTYARD - DAY

The courtyard, once a tranquil oasis, now transforms into a dystopian dreamscape. Neon lights flicker to life, casting an ethereal glow over the stone flags. The sound of distant, warped synthesizers wafts through the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors, now donning futuristic attire, gather around the throne. They gaze upon a holographic display projecting an endless loop of distorted, VHS-style footage.

ADVISOR 2
(awed)
Your Majesty, this is... breathtaking.

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
I have summoned the greatest minds in the land to create an immersive experience, a sensory overload that will redefine our empire's identity.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The stone walls, once imposing, now display a mesmerizing array of glitch art. Distorted, pixelated images of ancient battles and mythical creatures swirl across the surface.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, surrounded by his advisors, sits upon his throne, a look of serene contentment on his face.

KING EVERARD
(leaning back)
Our empire shall be reborn, a beacon of innovation and style in a world of dusty relics.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans up, revealing the castle's facade, now a swirling vortex of color and light. The once-majestic structure has become a proto-vaporwave wonderland, a testament to the king's unorthodox vision.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
